candidates.plot: Amal (Aziza Amir), a young widow with two toddlers, loses her husband Riyad. His brother Mokhtar (Hussein Fawzi) returns from abroad and marries her by his mother's request, agreeing to live as siblings to raise his brother's children in Cairo.  Unspoken love grows, but after a drunken night at his friend Sadiq's (Stephan Rosti) party, Mokhtar sleeps with Amal and, consumed by guilt, moves out and takes a job in Sudan.  Amal discovers she is pregnant. Her mother-in-law prevents an abortion and she gives birth to Osman. Two years later Mokhtar returns, takes the boy, divorces Amal, and leaves Egypt.  Years later, Hassan is an accountant, Huda (Badriya Raafat) a fashion designer, and Osman (Abdel Salam Al-Nabulsi) an engineer. Engaged to Hayat (Assia Dagher), Osman returns to Egypt and meets Huda while shopping for a wedding dress — unaware she is both his cousin and his sister.

Martia, tells him that Elise's father is in need of a superintendent, and suggests that he take a letter from her recommending him for the position. Pascale grasps the opportunity and proceeds to Florida. Elise's father gives him employment. Elise is unconsciously attracted by Pascale, but not aware that he is her chum's brother, and seeing him as her father's foreman, keeps him at arm's length. Pascale loses no opportunity to show his love for Elise. Elise realizing she is falling in love with him, goes to her father and asks him to send her away. On her arrival at Martia's home Elise tells her secret. Martia telegraphs Pascale to come home at once. The young man quickly follows and prosecutes his suit to a successful ending.

candidates.plot: In a remote fishing community in the north of Denmark live 575 Thai women married to Danish men. Fifteen years ago, there were almost none. But Sommai was there – a former sex worker from Pattaya. Now, she and a group of other industrious and strong Thai women are trying to find a man for Sommai's young niece Kaeh who is in Denmark on a three-month tourist visa. A different kind of love story, the film gives an intimate insight into the special relationships between Danish men and their Thai wives who all try to outlive the idea of Western happiness and thereby achieve respect and social status back home in Thailand.

candidates.plot: Following a yearlong attendance upon his shogun in Edo, samurai Hikokuro makes a long-awaited return to his home and doting wife, Dane. Initially greeted by the effusive welcome of his family, spiteful whispers also reach his ear about an adulterous affair carried on, in his long absence, between his wife and a famous drummer. With Hikokuro’s honor imperiled by rumor, his family insists on a formal investigation into the veracity of the gossip. Through the combined testimony of many witnesses, a tale unwinds around the visits of a traveling musician hired to tutor the family heir, the spurned attentions of the man who started the rumor, and the ultimate truth behind the accusations. The conclusion of events prove as much an indictment of bushidō as it is of the reluctant parties involved. Adapted from a 1706 play by Chikamatsu Monzaemon and based on a true case.

candidates.tagline: The 2015 Championship Journey
candidates.plot: Go behind the scenes with the Hyundai A-League​ Premiers and Champions when the special documentary The Road to Victory premieres on Fox Sports 505 at 7.30pm AEDT on Tuesday, October 27.  The Hyundai A-League 2014/15 season yielded Melbourne Victory its third Premiership-Championship double since the club's inception in 2005.  The Road to Victory takes you inside the club as key personnel reflect on how Victory achieved the ultimate success in its 10th anniversary season.  Exclusive interviews with chairman Anthony Di Pietro, head coach Kevin Muscat, former captain Mark Milligan, club stalwart Leigh Broxham and 2014/15 signings Besart Berisha, Fahid Ben Khalfallah and Matthieu Delpierre tell the story from the inner sanctum.

metadata.title: Queen Live in Budapest
metadata.plot: On 27th July 1986, British Stadium Rock Band Queen broke new ground by playing for the first time in Hungary, a country which was still under a communist dictatorship behind the Iron Curtain. Hungarian Rhapsody: Queen Live in Budapest is a concert film of the British rock band Queen's performance in Budapest on 27 July 1986. It was part of the band's final tour with original lead singer Freddie Mercury, The Magic Tour. Queen were one of the few bands from Western Europe to perform in the Eastern Bloc during the Cold War. The film had a limited release in theatres worldwide on 20 September 2012. The concert was released on DVD and Blu-ray for the first time on 5 November 2012 worldwide, except in the United States where it was released a day later. The concert title is a play on the Hungarian Rhapsodies by Franz Liszt and one of Queen's most celebrated hits, "Bohemian Rhapsody."

candidates.plot: 'Festival' is a black comedy set during the annual Edinburgh Fringe festival. The film is based around both the judging of a major comedy award and the performers at one of the smaller venues. Various plot strands interweave, including the bitter relationship between a famous self-obsessed British comic and his ever-suffering assistant, an actress debuting at the festival with a one-woman show about Dorothy Wordsworth and a depressed, rich housewife who spies on the stoned Canadian theatre troupe to whom she has rented out her house

candidates.plot: Jean-Claude Rousseau is a filmmaker who believes in the natural power of images. The rigid compositions create something like a pure state, which constantly changes during the period of its viewing – like an empty and simultaneously detail-packed field. During this period the viewer is challenged to find and occupy his own position, to find his perspective in a similar way the filmmaker has found his in several places. Festival combines places the artist has visited during the last few years. Jean-Claude Rousseau’s films not only make beautiful discoveries, they are beautiful discoveries.

candidates.plot: The annual film festival in Venice is, of course, an ideal place to make a film (how come no-one has thought of it before). Everything is there in Pupi Avati's Festival: the famous hotels Des Bain and Excelsior on the Lido, the shimmering sandy beach which captivated Visconti. The film was made last spring and exploits the presence of passing film stars such as Jack Nicholson. We see the hysterical press conferences, where journalists and experts ask intelligent questions-without listening to the answers.

candidates.plot: Black and white footage of performances, interviews, and conversations at the Newport Folk Festival, from 1963 to 1966. The headliners are Peter, Paul and Mary, Joan Baez, Pete Seeger, and Bob Dylan, who's acoustic and electric. Son House and Mike Bloomfield talk about the blues; John Hurt, Howlin' Wolf, and Sonny Terry and Brownie McGhee show its range. The Osborne Brothers perform bluegrass. Donovan, Johnny Cash, Judy Collins, Mimi and Dick Farina, and others less well known also perform. Several talk musical philosophy, and there's a running commentary about the nature and appeal of folk music. The crowd looks clean cut.

candidates.plot: Different bands every Thursday and mass karaoke have turned the roundabout at Sternbrücke into a cult location. alternativeTitles: Neurosia: Who Shot Rosa von Praunheim?
candidates.plot: Neurosia is the autobiography of the director Rosa von Praunheim. The movie begins with Rosa presenting his autobiography in a movie theater. Before the film begins, he is shot. But - his body gets lost. A female journalist from a TV station begins researching the life of Rosa. In the course of the movie she speaks to lots of aquaintances, shows short clips from Rosas old movies. Her main aim is to provide sensational and shocking details from Rosas life. It turns out that nearly everybody had some reason to kill Rosa. At the end of the movie, she discovers Rosa at a boat where he is kept prisoner by some of his old enemies. She frees him, and the movie ends.

candidates.plot: Merlyn Solakhan’s feature documentary The City offers an unusual narrative on Istanbul. Solakhan roams every inch of the city, witnessing separate instances of standing stones, balloons, kites, cars, roads, and neighborhoods with her camera, whilst looking into the city’s nature, yesterday and today. The city from her perspective is intertwined with history. An essay film as well as a documentary, The City is a daring gaze on Istanbul. The movie goes beyond observation to working through and reflecting on the city, with no hesitation in bestowing a new image on it and seeing it in a new light.

candidates.plot: Rainer Langhans – the old hippie with the long, white hair – is preparing for his death. The self-proclaimed last of the ‘68ers, co-founder of Commune 1, self-promoter, and contradictory outsider lives with his companions and rehearses dying. Through interviews with companions, siblings, and confidants, previously unpublished archive material, and offbeat, fictional scenes, a multi-layered portrait emerges – sometimes serious, sometimes ironic, always contradictory. How can this flamboyant media figure be captured? And what remains when the pose fades? A final look at an eccentric dreamer who always only wanted one thing: to be human.

candidates.plot: Rainer Langhans – the old hippie with the long, white hair – is preparing for his death. The self-proclaimed last of the ‘68ers, co-founder of Commune 1, self-promoter, and contradictory outsider lives with his companions and rehearses dying. Through interviews with companions, siblings, and confidants, previously unpublished archive material, and offbeat, fictional scenes, a multi-layered portrait emerges – sometimes serious, sometimes ironic, always contradictory. How can this flamboyant media figure be captured? And what remains when the pose fades? A final look at an eccentric dreamer who always only wanted one thing: to be human.

candidates.tagline: “There is no incurable‒ God is the greatest physician!”
candidates.plot: In 1949 one name dominates the headlines: Bruno Gröning. Newspapers print special editions, radio and newsreels report about him. A film is made. Wherever he goes, thousands of people throng from all over to see him. Gröning becomes an international sensation.  Most of those who come to him are not fans or followers. They are sick people. Beaten down by war, given up on by doctors, these people had only one wish: to become healthy, free from suffering and pain. They want Bruno Gröning to help them. And he does help them. “There is no incurable‒ God is the greatest physician!” Those are his words. And the inconceivable happens.  The documentary film “The Phenomenon Bruno Gröning” traces the dramatic events of that time with original film and sound recordings, archival material, more than 50 eyewitness interviews, as well elaborate film re-enactments.  Gröning died in 1959 but extraordinary healings are still occurring today.

film-69e38a0981462fbfa56273b6.value: FOREIGNERS OUT! SCHLINGENSIEFS CONTAINER is a thrilling, insightful, funny chronicle and reflection of one of he biggest public pranks and acts of art terrorism ever committed. Austria 2000: Right after the FPÖ under Jörg Haider had become part of the government, the first time an extreme right wing party became state officials after WW2, infamous German shock director Christoph Schlingensief showed a very unique form of protest. Realising public xenophobia and the new hate politics in the most drastic ways possible, he installed a public concentration camp right in the middle of Vienna's touristic heart, right beside the picturesque opera where hundreds of tourists and locals pass by daily. And it was no concentration camp you had ever feared to return from the old times, but one that cynically reflected our new multimedia culture. Satirising reality TV shows, "Big Brother" especially, a dozen asylum seekers were surveilled by a multitude of cameras, could be fed and watched by.

movies.plot: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.

movies.title: Ein Nobody gegen Putin

movies.title: Lovebox

Inside the LOVEBOX, two strangers meet for a few minutes and explore a question about love. Their encounters give rise to unexpected moments of connection and self-discovery. When the dust of the festival settles, the friends set out to bring the magic of the LOVEBOX into everyday life. But can the openness and sense of connection they experienced at AfrikaBurn survive beyond its temporary utopia?

movies.title: Queen Budapest
movies.plot: On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury. Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favorite tracks—"Bohemian Rhapsody,” "Crazy Little Thing Called Love," "I Want To Break Free” and "We Are The Champions." With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the country’s top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity

movies.title: Berlinized
movies.plot: The documentary BERLINIZED describes this very Berlin-specific attitude in a reflection on and a journey to mid-1990s' Berlin. Filmmaker Lucian Busse, an active protagonist of the period, documents the transformation of Berlin after the Wall. But Berlinized represents more than just the 1990s - it is a metaphor for this virally catching creative feeling, the slightly rough directness, spiced up with a big dash of typical Berlin humor. Berlinized lets the former protagonists reflect how that temporary feeling of freedom shaped their individual lives, and to what degree that freedom can still be found among the neat order of today's Berlin. These reflections are as diverse as the interviewees and as multifaceted as the changes in those times.

movies.title: Human - Die Menschheit
movies.plot: A collection of stories about and images of our world, offering an immersion to the core of what it means to be human. Through these stories full of love and happiness, as well as hatred and violence, it brings us face to face with the Other, making us reflect on our lives. From stories of everyday experiences to accounts of the most unbelievable lives, these poignant encounters share a rare sincerity and underline who we are – our darker side, but also what is most noble in us, and what is universal. Our Earth is shown at its most sublime through never-before-seen aerial images accompanied by soaring music, resulting in an ode to the beauty of the world, providing a moment to draw breath and for introspection. This film is a politically engaged work which allows us to embrace the human condition and to reflect on the meaning of our existence.

movies.plot: Marnie is a beautiful but emotionally withdrawn thief, stealing from employers before disappearing under new identities. When her new boss, Mark Rutland, discovers her secret, his fascination turns to obsession, and he blackmails her into marriage, convinced he can cure her. But as he probes deeper into Marnie’s fractured mind, long-buried fears and compulsions begin to surface.
movies.tagline: The more he loved her . . . The more she hated him . . . For trying to unravel her secret!

movies.title: Der Fremde im Zug
movies.plot: A charming psychopath tries to coerce a tennis star into his theory that two strangers can commit the perfect crime by exchanging murders—each killing the other’s most-hated person.
movies.tagline: It starts with a shriek of a train whistle... and ends with shrieking excitement!

movies.title: Uhrwerk Orange
movies.plot: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?
movies.tagline: Being the adventures of a young man whose principal interests are rape, ultra-violence and Beethoven.

movies.title: Familiengrab
movies.plot: Spiritualist Blanche Tyler and her cab-driving boyfriend encounter a pair of serial kidnappers while trailing a missing heir in California.
movies.tagline: There's no body in the family plot.

movies.title: Camouflage
movies.plot: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

movies.title: Erpressung
movies.plot: London, 1929. Frank Webber, a very busy Scotland Yard detective, seems to be more interested in his work than in Alice White, his girlfriend. Feeling herself ignored, Alice agrees to go out with an elegant and well-mannered artist who invites her to visit his fancy apartment.
movies.tagline: A romance of Scotland Yard

movies.title: Die Blutgräfin
movies.plot: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.
movies.tagline: Blood is eternal, and so is power.

movies.title: Im Schatten des Zweifels
movies.plot: In sleepy Santa Rosa, restless young Charlie’s world brightens when her sophisticated Uncle Charlie arrives for a long visit. But as his behavior grows increasingly strange, she begins to suspect that her beloved uncle may be hiding a terrible secret—and that danger has quietly entered her home.
movies.tagline: What horror did her secret life hold… that made her dread this man of her dreams?

movies.title: 2001 - Odyssee im Weltraum
movies.plot: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the help of HAL 9000, the world's most advanced super computer.
movies.tagline: An epic drama of adventure and exploration.

movies.title: Kommissar Bellamy
movies.plot: A well known Parisian inspector becomes involved in an investigation while on holiday.

movies.title: Der Exorzist
movies.plot: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
movies.tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.

movies.title: Red Soil
movies.plot: Freshly hired as a labor nurse in a chemical factory, Nour discovers that small arrangements exist between management and her father, Slimane, the staff representative, and the company's pivot. Lies about polluting discharges, hidden illnesses of employees, hidden accidents ... Nour, little by little, no longer accepts the compromises of his father to preserve the image of the company. She decides to launch the alert.

movies.title: Made In Hongkong
movies.plot: Documentary about the working poor in Hongkong.

movies.title: Die Monster AG
movies.plot: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the monsters who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.
movies.tagline: It's nothing personal. It's just their job.

movies.title: Bitteres Fest
movies.plot: In 2004, advertising director Elsa Rosado faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, filmmaker Raúl Durán turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and those closest to him.
movies.tagline: You’re confusing fiction with reality.

movies.title: Hirten
movies.plot: A young Montreal advertising executive, converted to a Provençal shepherd, has various misadventures with a civil servant who has cavalierly quit her job.

movies.title: Shorts Attack! - The Kids are alright
movies.criticTitle: Shorts Attack! - The Kids are alright
sourceTitles: Shorts Attack! - The Kids are alright
movies.plot: The Parrs' baby Jack-Jack is thought to be normal, not having any super-powers like his parents or siblings. But when an outsider is hired to watch him, Jack-Jack shows his true potential.

movies.title: Watching People Watching Birds
movies.plot: Highly topical, serious and humorous, this film observes people who are passionately devoted to bird watching. Through their eyes and ears, we discover the world of the birds that becomes a metaphor for the state of the world.

movies.title: Barfuß durch die Hölle - 2. Teil: Die Straße zur Ewigkeit
movies.criticTitle: Barfuß durch die Hölle - 2. Teil: Die Straße zur Ewigkeit
sourceTitles: Barfuß durch die Hölle - 2. Teil: Die Straße zur Ewigkeit
movies.originalTitle: 人間の條件　第３部望郷篇／第４部戦雲篇
movies.plot: Kaji, sent to the Japanese army labeled Red, witnesses cruelties in the army and revolts against the abusive treatment against a fellow recruit. He also sees his friend Shinjô defecting to the Russian border, and he ends in the front to fight a lost battle against the Russian tanks division.
movies.tmdbTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
movies.tagline: The second one

movies.title: Blade Runner - Final Cut
movies.plot: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.
movies.tagline: Man has made his match ...now it's his problem.

movies.title: Chikamatsu's Love in Osaka
movies.plot: Chubei, the adopted son of an Osaka courier, falls desperately in love with the courtesan Umegawa. To prevent a wealthy client from purchasing her, he steals money from his employer to buy her freedom himself. Now hunted criminals, the lovers flee toward Yamato, pursued by the law.

movies.title: Her Brother
movies.plot: Set in 1926 when Japanese tradition was much stronger, this drama looks at the inner workings of a small family, especially the relationship between a sister and brother.

movies.title: Night Drum
movies.plot: Following a yearlong attendance upon his shogun in Edo, samurai Hikokuro makes a long-awaited return to his home and doting wife, Dane. Initially greeted by the effusive welcome of his family, spiteful whispers also reach his ear about an adulterous affair carried on, in his long absence, between his wife and a famous drummer. With Hikokuro’s honor imperiled by rumor, his family insists on a formal investigation into the veracity of the gossip. Through the combined testimony of many witnesses, a tale unwinds around the visits of a traveling musician hired to tutor the family heir, the spurned attentions of the man who started the rumor, and the ultimate truth behind the accusations. The conclusion of events prove as much an indictment of bushidō as it is of the reluctant parties involved. Adapted from a 1706 play by Chikamatsu Monzaemon and based on a true case.

movies.title: Sommerblüten
movies.plot: Wataru's outwardly liberal views on marriage are severely tested when his daughter declares her love for a coworker and is adamant to live her own way, instead of agreeing to an arranged marriage. Outwitted by his female relatives, Hirayama stubbornly refuses to admit defeat.

movies.title: The Snow Flurry
movies.plot: After surviving the double suicide pact she made with her lover, a woman gives birth to their child.

movies.title: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty
sourceTitles: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty
movies.originalTitle: West Indies ou les Nègres marrons de la liberté
movies.plot: Aboard a giant slave ship in an abandoned Citroën factory, the history of the West Indies is traced through several centuries of French oppression. The ship becomes a stage for the people to tell stories via song and dance—from their enslavement to their displacement in Metropolitan France.
movies.tmdbTitle: West Indies: The Fugitive Slaves of Liberty

movies.title: Zero Focus
movies.plot: One week into newlywed Teiko Uhara's marriage, her husband, Kenichi, leaves on a short business trip and never returns. Teiko travels across Japan to search for him, and along the way discovers some surprising facts about her husband's past. With only a pair of old photographs among his belongings to go off of, Teiko tries to figure out what has happened to him.

movies.title: A new Dawn
movies.plot: The Obinata Fireworks Shop factory is getting prepared for an administrative action for confiscation tomorrow. It has been six years since Keitaro has been holed up in a closed-down factory creating fireworks by himself, chasing after an illusion of his father who vanished. It is a story about three young people who overcome the extreme weather conditions, disasters and environmental problems imposed on them and establish their own identities.

movies.title: All my Sisters
movies.plot: Growing up in Tehran, a capital of the 21st century... From 2007 to 2025, within a loving family, eighteen years in the life of three sisters, from their early childhood to their daily lives as young women in search of freedom. Brought up in the traditional way, witnessing the struggles of a youth in perpetual movement, what is their future in today's Iranian society?

movies.title: Für immer 16
movies.plot: Charlotte, Helena, and Oskar haven't really been in touch since their experimental filmmaking group disbanded. A shared vacation aims to reunite the bitterly estranged trio, but envy and jealousy soon flare up again. Things get really complicated when Rudolph joins the group and they decide to make a film about a female serial killer.

movies.title: Boris Skossyreff, the Scammer who became a King
sourceTitles: Boris Skossyreff, the Scammer who became a King

movies.title: Der Himmel über Berlin
movies.plot: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.
movies.tagline: There are angels on the streets of Berlin.

movies.title: Governance - The Price of Power
movies.plot: Renzo Petrucci is forced to leave his job as general manager of a multinational oil company after corruption charges. Convinced that the woman who has taken his place has betrayed him, Renzo takes his revenge by killing her. Reinstated by the Board, he works his way up to the top, driving his company to new heights despite the growing suspicion and mistrust...

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.plot: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the rich and the poor, the son of the city's mastermind meets a prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.
movies.tagline: There can be no understanding between the hands and the brain unless the heart acts as mediator.

movies.title: O Dia que Durou 21 Anos
movies.plot: Stunning espionage documentary on the US conspiracy that led to the 1964 Brazilian coup d'état. John F. Kennedy and Lyndon Johnson original White House tapes, and CIA Top Secret documents reveal how the US government planned to overthrow Brazilian elected president João Goulart.

movies.title: Sisters with Transistors
movies.plot: Think of early electronic music and you’ll likely see men pushing buttons, knobs, and boundaries. While electronic music is often perceived as a boys' club, the truth is that from the very beginning women have been integral in inventing the devices, techniques and tropes that would define the shape of sound for years to come.
movies.tagline: Electronic music's unsung heroines

movies.title: Wege zum Ruhm
movies.plot: A commanding officer defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.
movies.tagline: It explodes in the no-man's land no picture ever dared cross before!

movies.title: Vaiana
movies.plot: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.
movies.tagline: The ocean chose her for a reason.

movies.title: Drishyam - The Conclusion

UCI KINOWELT Berlin - East Side Gallery | Luxe

movies.plot: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.
movies.tagline: Visuals Can Be Deceptive

movies.title: Rodychi
movies.plot: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.

movies.title: London
movies.plot: London is a drug laden adventure that centers on a party in a New York loft where a young man is trying to win back his ex-girlfriend.
movies.tagline: One young man's incredible journey of self-discovery

movies.title: Oh, mom!
movies.plot: How much is contained in these two words—irritation, tenderness, laughter, love. And a little shame, when she knows everything about you. Even what you yourself have forgotten. This film is about all mothers and for all of us. About those moments when you say, “Mooom, don’t start”—and she starts. About the calls with the question, “Have you eaten?” when you are in a courtroom or on a date. About superpowers that work even thousands of kilometers away.

movies.title: Silent Flood
movies.plot: Set by a beautiful river canyon in Western Ukraine, a pacifist community with unique religious beliefs, sees their peaceful way of life gradually distressed by regular floods and eventually an unexpected war.

movies.title: Lebensansichten eines Huhns
movies.plot: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

movies.title: Mond
movies.plot: Sarah, a former professional kickboxer from Vienna, accepts an offer to work as a personal trainer for a rich family in the Middle East. She finds herself in a foreign world, in a palace behind walls and cut off from the internet, where the sisters are under surveillance around the clock. They have no interest in learning to box. So why has Sarah been brought here?

movies.title: The Testament of Ann Lee
movies.plot: The extraordinary true legend of Ann Lee, founder of the devotional sect known as the Shakers, who preached gender and social equality and was revered by her followers as the female Christ.
movies.tagline: The Earth will shake and tremble.

movies.title: A Moment of Romance
movies.plot: After a young Triad member takes an upper-class girl hostage during his escape from a jewelry heist, the two find themselves falling in love, in spite of the repercussions caused by their forbidden relationship.

movies.title: Love on Delivery
movies.plot: Ho Kam-An is a lovestruck dim sum delivery boy who falls for a beautiful judo student. After being humiliated by her boyfriend, Ho Kam-An seeks the services of an aging master who teaches him a half-assed style of kung fu, "Karate Kid"-style.

movies.title: Made in Hong Kong
movies.plot: After his father abandons the family, Autumn Moon drops out of high school and becomes a debt collector for the Triads. On his rounds, he meets and falls in love with Ping, a daughter of one of the Triads' clients. She is suffering from a fatal kidney disease, and to pay for her medical expenses, Autumn Moon takes an assassination contract, but as he slips deeper into the criminal underworld, he's haunted by a figure from his past.

movies.title: Nadja
movies.plot: In a contemporary New York City, members of a dysfunctional family of vampires are trying to come to terms with each other, in the wake of their father's death. Meanwhile, they are being hunted by Dr. Van Helsing and his hapless nephew. As in all good vampire movies, forces of love are pitted against forces of destruction.
movies.tagline: Unseen. Unforgiving. Undead.

movies.title: Rot
movies.plot: Thirteen-year-old Mei is experiencing the awkwardness of being a teenager with a twist – when she gets too excited, she transforms into a giant red panda.
movies.tagline: Growing up is a beast.

movies.title: Royal warriors - in the line of duty
movies.criticTitle: Royal warriors - in the line of duty
sourceTitles: Royal warriors - in the line of duty
movies.plot: When a tough policewoman learns about a group of violent terrorists, she, along with her partner and a Japanese detective, does everything it takes to take them down.
movies.tagline: She's the last line of defense. And it's a line you don't want to cross.

movies.title: Seeding of a Ghost
movies.plot: After the wife of a taxi driver is raped and killed by two teenage hooligans, he pleads with a sorcerer to lift the hex and exact revenge.

movies.title: Shanghai Blues
movies.plot: In 1937 Shanghai, a soldier and a young woman have an awkward meet-cute in darkness under a bridge as they seek refuge during a bomb raid. Ten years later, the soldier, now a burgeoning songwriter and tuba player in a marching band, is back in town desperately searching for his would-be soulmate. As fate would have it, they end up living in the same building, unbeknownst to each other.

movies.title: Swordsman
movies.plot: A kung-fu manual known as the Sacred Scroll is stolen from the Emperor's library. An army detachment is sent to recover it. Meanwhile, a young swordsman and his fellow disciple are accidentally drawn into the chaos.

movies.title: Sternbrücke Forever
movies.plot: A declaration of love to an edifice and its people, and a tirade against urban politics. Mehmet sells falafel, Martina has a kiosk and Stefan repairs cars. And every weekend, young people fill the clubs under the Sternbrücke – one of more than a hundred old railway bridges in Hamburg. But its time is up: the plan is to take down the bridge and replace it.

movies.title: Love Island
movies.plot: A pregnant French woman lives in Sarajevo with her Bosnian husband and their daughter. They vacation at a Croatian island, where things get complicated when they all become attracted to a beautiful woman.

movies.title: Die Mörder sind unter uns
movies.plot: After returning from a concentration camp, Susanne finds a traumatized ex-soldier living in her apartment in bombed out Berlin. Together the two try to move past their experiences during WWII.

movies.title: Sonne im Netz
movies.plot: A married woman and a drifter fall in love, then plot to murder her husband.
movies.tagline: Their Love was a Flame that Destroyed!

movies.title: Audre Lorde - Die Berliner Jahre 1984 bis 1992
movies.criticTitle: Audre Lorde - Die Berliner Jahre 1984 bis 1992
sourceTitles: Audre Lorde - Die Berliner Jahre 1984 bis 1992
movies.plot: Audre Lorde, the highly influential, award-winning African-American lesbian poet came to live in West-Berlin in the 80s and early '90s. She was the mentor and catalyst who helped ignite the Afro-German movement while she challenged white women to acknowledge and constructively use their privileges. With her active support a whole generation of writers and poets for the first time gave voice to their unique experience as people of color in Germany. This documentary contains previously unreleased audiovisual material from director Dagmar Schultz's archives including stunning images of Audre Lorde off stage. With testimony from Lorde's colleagues and friends the film documents Lorde's lasting legacy in Germany and the impact of her work and personality.

movies.title: Heart of Light - Eleven Songs for Fiji
movies.criticTitle: Heart of Light - Eleven Songs for Fiji
sourceTitles: Heart of Light - Eleven Songs for Fiji
movies.plot: When the humiliation and grief of his eldest son's shooting rampage and subsequent suicide threatens to pull him under, Rasmus leaves his family and tight-knit community and heads into Greenland's bleak landscape. As he journeys forth aimlessly on an old dogsled, he eventually finds solace in the form of a mystical hermit.

movies.title: Schönheit & Vergänglichkeit
movies.plot: Sven Marquardt might be the most famous bouncer worldwide. But beside standing in front of the legendary techno club Berghain in Berlin, he is also a well-known and skilled photographer. Long before the Berlin Wall came down, Marquardt portrayed the subcultural East-Berlin scene. His black and white photography illustrates it as voluptuous, laid-back, dirty and existential. Even if shot by daylight, his work is permeated by darkness, ecstasy and night.

movies.title: Jin-Roh
movies.plot: A member of an elite paramilitary counter-terrorism unit becomes traumatized after witnessing the suicide bombing of a young girl and is forced to undergo retraining. However, unbeknownst to him, he becomes a key player in a dispute between rival police divisions, as he finds himself increasingly involved with the sister of the girl he saw die.
movies.tagline: A story of a man burdened with the destiny of a beast and a woman who dreamed of love.

movies.title: Shin Godzilla
movies.plot: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens.  A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower.  But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.
movies.tagline: A god incarnate. A city doomed.

movies.title: Diamanti
movies.plot: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

movies.title: Lady
movies.plot: Lady Bird McPherson, a strong willed, deeply opinionated, artistic 17 year old comes of age in Sacramento. Her relationship with her mother and her upbringing are questioned and tested as she plans to head off to college.
movies.tagline: Fly away home.

movies.title: Sleep No More
movies.plot: It's 1986 and a group of grad students are close to discovering what happens to the human brain after staying awake for 200 hours, but something goes terribly wrong with a test subject. After their department is shut down, the team moves forward in secret - only this time on themselves.
movies.tagline: Your Dreams Will Become Your Nightmare

movies.title: B-Movie: Lust & Sound in West-Berlin 1979-1989
movies.plot: The wild West Berlin of the 1980s became the creative melting pot of pop subcultures: music, art and chaos. Before the Iron Curtain fell, anything and everything seemed possible.
movies.tagline: If you can remember the 80's, you weren't there!

movies.plot: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.
movies.tagline: The system is unstable.

movies.title: Five Fingers for Marseilles
movies.plot: Years ago, the young Five Fingers fought for the rural town of Marseilles against brutal police oppression. Now, after fleeing in disgrace, Tau, one of them, returns to Marseilles, seeking only a peaceful life. When he finds the town under new threat, he must reluctantly fight to free it.
movies.tagline: There are no good men

movies.title: Antarctica 3D - Narrated by Benedict Cumberbatch
movies.plot: Two Japanese scientists, Ushioda and Ochi, develop a bond with their sled dogs while on an expedition in Antarctica.
movies.tagline: Amidst the coldest, harshest surroundings on earth, this true story celebrates the mystery and the warmth of life.

movies.title: Ghost School
movies.plot: Carola is a mischievous girl who doesn't care much for school- except for sports and recess, of course. Without her good friend Willi to keep her on the straight and narrow, she would really be in trouble. One day at school, Carola has an idea. She invents what she calls "International Ghosts' Day" and a ghost named "Buh" to go with it. When Buh turns out to be less-than-imaginary the two decide to switch places, with Buh taking on all the schoolwork, and Carola taking the opportunity to play practical jokes on all her friends...

movies.title: Mein Nachbar Totoro
movies.plot: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.
movies.tagline: He's your friendly neighbourhood forest spirit!

movies.title: The Beauty of Ballroom
movies.plot: If the world doesn’t accept you and your kind, trailblaze a world that does. Inspired by the Black and Latinx underground Ballroom culture of New York, Sun, Teddy, and Xyza create Ballroom communities in Southeast Asia as safe havens from homophobia, transphobia, color discrimination and HIV stigma.

data.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
data.overview: Vier Jahre sind seit den Ereignissen von „No Way Home“ vergangen. Peter ist nun erwachsen und lebt für sich allein, nachdem er sich freiwillig aus dem Leben und den Erinnerungen derer, die er liebt, ausgelöscht hat. Er bekämpft Verbrechen in einem New York, das ihn und seinen Namen nicht mehr kennt, und widmet sich ganz dem Schutz seiner Stadt: Spider-Man in Vollzeit. Doch mit den steigenden Anforderungen löst der Druck eine überraschende körperliche Veränderung aus, die seine Existenz bedroht – gerade als eine seltsame neue Art von Verbrechen eine der mächtigsten Bedrohungen hervorbringt, denen er je gegenüberstand.

details.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
details.tagline: A brand new day starts now.

data.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
data.tagline: A brand new day starts now.

data.overview: Han pasado cuatro años desde los acontecimientos de No Way Home, y Peter Parker ahora es un adulto que vive completamente solo, ha desaparecido voluntariamente de las vidas y recuerdos de quienes ama. Combatiendo el crimen en una Nueva York que ya no conoce su nombre, se ha dedicado por completo a proteger su ciudad—un Spider-Man a tiempo completo—, pero a medida que aumentan las exigencias sobre él, la presión desencadena una evolución física que amenaza su existencia, al mismo tiempo que un extraño nuevo patrón de crímenes da lugar a una de las amenazas más poderosas a las que se ha enfrentado.
data.tagline: Un nuevo día comienza ahora.

data.overview: Vier Jahre sind seit den Ereignissen von „No Way Home“ vergangen. Peter ist nun erwachsen und lebt für sich allein, nachdem er sich freiwillig aus dem Leben und den Erinnerungen derer, die er liebt, ausgelöscht hat. Er bekämpft Verbrechen in einem New York, das ihn und seinen Namen nicht mehr kennt, und widmet sich ganz dem Schutz seiner Stadt: Spider-Man in Vollzeit. Doch mit den steigenden Anforderungen löst der Druck eine überraschende körperliche Veränderung aus, die seine Existenz bedroht – gerade als eine seltsame neue Art von Verbrechen eine der mächtigsten Bedrohungen hervorbringt, denen er je gegenüberstand.
data.tagline: Ein brandneuer Tag beginnt.

data.overview: 4년 전 소중한 사람들을 지키기 위해 모두의 기억에서 사라진 피터 파커. 친절한 이웃 스파이더맨으로서 뉴욕을 지키며 고독한 삶을 살아가던 피터는 어느 날, 예상치 못한 DNA 변이로 인해 통제 불가능한 힘에 사로잡히고 그의 진짜 정체를 알고 있는 적까지 마주하게 된다. 타인의 의식을 조종하는 정체불명의 존재로 인해 모두가 피터를 노리는 적이 될 수 있는 혼란 속에서 피터는 다시 위협에 빠진 MJ와 모두를 지키기 위해 스파이더맨으로 그들 앞에 서게 되는데...
data.tagline: 스파이더맨의 새로운 날을 확인하라!
data.title: 스파이더맨: 브랜드 뉴 데이

data.overview: Không còn Tony Stark, MJ hay Ned kề cận, Peter buộc phải đơn thân độc mã đối diện với phe đối đầu bí ẩn. Tuy nhiên, khi áp lực ngày càng gia tăng, nó kích hoạt một sự biến đổi thể chất bất ngờ, đe dọa chính sự tồn tại của anh. Đồng thời, một chuỗi tội phạm bí ẩn mới xuất hiện, kéo theo một trong những mối đe dọa mạnh mẽ nhất mà Spider-Man từng đối mặt.
data.title: Người Nhện: Khởi Đầu Mới

data.overview: Είναι μια καινούργια μέρα για τον Πίτερ Πάρκερ, που έχει πλέον αφοσιωθεί στην καταπολέμηση του εγκλήματος ως Σπαϊντερ-Μαν. Κυκλοφορεί όμως σε έναν κόσμο που δεν τον θυμάται πια με τους παλιούς του φίλους να συνεχίζουν τη ζωή τους χωρίς εκείνον. Η νέα κατάσταση τού επιφυλάσσει μία ανεξέλεγκτη αλλαγή και αυτή η μεταμόρφωση μπορεί να είναι η μοναδική ελπίδα για να αποκρούσει μια νέα απειλή που στρέφεται εναντίον της πόλης και των ανθρώπων που αγαπά: έναν πανίσχυρο αντίπαλο που κανείς δεν μπορεί να δει. Ο κόσμος μπορεί να ξέχασε τον Peter Parker, εκείνος όμως δεν έχει ξεχάσει κανέναν.
data.tagline: Ο κόσμος μπορεί να ξέχασε τον Πίτερ Πάρκερ, εκείνος όμως δεν έχει ξεχάσει κανέναν.
data.title: Spider-Man: Καινούργια Μέρα

data.overview: Quatre ans se sont écoulés, Peter, désormais adulte, vit seul, s'est volontairement effacé de la vie et des souvenirs de ses proches. Luttant contre le crime dans un New York qui ne le reconnaît plus, il se consacre entièrement à la protection de la ville - un Spider-Man à plein temps - mais à mesure que les responsabilités s'intensifient, la pression provoque une transformation physique surprenante qui menace son existence, tandis qu'une étrange nouvelle vague de crimes donne naissance à l'une des menaces les plus redoutables qu'il ait jamais affrontées.
data.tagline: Le monde a peut-être oublié Peter Parker, mais lui, il ne les a pas oubliés.
data.title: Spider-Man : Brand New Day

data.overview: Este O ZI CU TOTUL NOUĂ pentru Peter Parker. Lupta sa cu normă întreagă, ca Spider-Man, împotriva criminalității, într-o lume care nu-și amintește de el - și presiunea de a-și vedea vechii prieteni mergând mai departe - declanșează o schimbare în Peter pe care s-ar putea să nu o poată controla. Dar această transformare ar putea fi, de asemenea, singurul lucru care poate opri o nouă amenințare șocantă la adresa orașului și a celor pe care îi iubește - un răufăcător extrem de puternic pe care nimeni nu-l poate vedea.
data.title: Omul-Păianjen: O nouă zi

data.overview: პიტერ პარკერი ცდილობს, მთელი დრო სწავლას დაუთმოს და სპაიდერმენი წარსულში დატოვოს. თუმცა როცა მის მეგობრებს ახალი საფრთხე დაემუქრებათ, პირობის დარღვევა და ისევ კოსტიუმში გამოწყობა მოუწევს. საყვარელი ადამიანების გადარჩენის გზაზე ის მოულოდნელ თანამებრძოლს შეიძენს.
data.title: სპაიდერმენი: ახალი დღე

data.overview: É um novo dia para Peter Parker. Combatendo o crime em tempo integral como Homem-Aranha em um mundo que não se lembra mais dele e lidando com a pressão de ver seus antigos amigos seguirem em frente sem sua presença, Peter passa por uma mudança que talvez nem ele tenha o poder de controlar. Mas essa transformação também pode ser a única coisa capaz de deter uma surpreendente nova ameaça à cidade e às pessoas que ele ama: um poderoso vilão que ninguém sequer consegue enxergar.
data.tagline: Um novo dia começa agora.
data.title: Homem-Aranha: Um Novo Dia

data.overview: Artık onu hatırlamayan bir dünyada tam zamanlı olarak Örümcek Adamlık yapmak ve eski arkadaşlarının hayatlarına o olmadan devam ettiklerini görmenin yarattığı baskı, Peter Parker'da kontrol edemeyeceği bir değişimi tetikler. Ancak bu değişim; şehre ve sevdiklerine yönelik olan yeni bir tehdidi, yani kimsenin göremediği güçlü bir düşmanı durdurabilecek tek şey de olabilir.
data.tagline: Yepyeni bir gün başlıyor.
data.title: Örümcek-Adam: Yepyeni Bir Gün

data.overview: A medida qué Spider-Man está en la cima de su carrera protegiendo la ciudad de Nueva York, una serie de crímenes inusuales lo arrastran a una red de misterios más grande de lo que jamás haya enfrentado.
data.tagline: Puede que el mundo se haya olvidado de Peter Parker, pero él no se ha olvidado de ellos.
data.title: Spider-Man: Un nuevo día

data.overview: 彼得·帕克以蜘蛛侠的身份全职打击犯罪，却发现自己的身体发生了无法控制的变化。与此同时，一股神秘而强大的新威胁正向他和所爱之人逼近。
data.tagline: 纵使被遗忘，依然在守护
data.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日

data.overview: Passaram-se quatro anos desde os acontecimentos de «Sem Volta a Casa», e Peter é agora um adulto que vive totalmente sozinho, tendo-se apagado voluntariamente da vida e das memórias daqueles que ama. A combater o crime numa Nova Iorque que já não conhece o seu nome, dedicou-se inteiramente a proteger a sua cidade — um Homem-Aranha a tempo inteiro — mas, à medida que as exigências sobre ele se intensificam, a pressão desencadeia uma surpreendente evolução física que ameaça a sua existência, mesmo quando um novo e estranho padrão de crimes dá origem a uma das ameaças mais poderosas que alguma vez enfrentou.
data.title: Homem-Aranha: Um Novo Dia

data.overview: Одинокий и повзрослевший Питер Паркер полностью посвящает себя борьбе с преступностью в Нью-Йорке, поскольку 4 года назад после заклинания Доктора Стрэнджа мир и все близкие забыли его. Но с ростом угроз и нагрузки на Человека-паука, его способности претерпевают странные изменения, способные поставить под угрозу его существование. Тем временем в городе случается новая цепочка преступлений, которая приводит к появлению одного из самых опасных противников в жизни Питера.
data.tagline: «Начинается новый день»
data.title: Человек-паук: Новый день

data.overview: Négy év telt el. A Nincs hazaút végén Pókember a magányt választotta. Önként, a világ érdekében kitörölte magát az emberek emlékezetéből és ezzel lemondott a szerelméről meg a jó barátjáról is. Magányos felnőttéletet él. New York már nem ismeri a nevét, csak élvezi áldásos működését: hiszen ő folytatja a bűn üldözését és már nincs semmi más dolga, főállású Pókember lett.  Mégis egyre többször van rá szükség. A rá nehezedő nyomás különös változásokat indít be a testében és végül odáig fajul, hogy már a létezését fenyegeti. Éppen akkor, amikor egészen újfajta bűncselekmények kezdenek terjedni a városban és neki élete legnagyobb ki hívásával kellene szembenéznie.
data.tagline: Most kezdődik egy vadonatúj nap.
data.title: Pókember: Vadonatúj nap

data.overview: Sono trascorsi quattro anni dagli eventi di No Way Home e Peter è ormai un adulto che vive completamente da solo, essendosi volontariamente cancellato dalla vita e dai ricordi di coloro che ama. Combattendo il crimine in una New York che non conosce più il suo nome, si è dedicato interamente alla protezione della sua città. Uno Spider-Man a tempo pieno. Ma con l'intensificarsi delle richieste, la pressione innesca una sorprendente evoluzione fisica che minaccia la sua stessa esistenza, mentre, una strana nuova serie di crimini, dà origine a una delle minacce più potenti che abbia mai affrontato.
data.tagline: Un nuovo giorno inizia ora.

data.overview: 彼得帕克努力專注於大學生活，把蜘蛛人拋在腦後。然而，當新的威脅危及到他的朋友時，他不得不違背諾言，再次穿上戰衣，與一位意想不到的盟友聯手，保護他所愛的人。
data.tagline: 重生日從現在開始⋯⋯
data.title: 蜘蛛人：重生日

data.overview: Минуло чотири роки від подій «Додому шляху немає». Пітер подорослішав і живе в цілковитій самотності, добровільно стерши себе з пам’яті тих, кого любить. Продовжуючи боротися зі злочинністю у Нью-Йорку, який більше не знає його імені, він цілковито присвятив себе захисту міста. Та зі зростанням навантаження тиск на нього лише посилюється, спричиняючи несподівану фізичну трансформацію, що загрожує самому його існуванню. Водночас дивна нова хвиля злочинів призводить до появи одного з наймогутніших ворогів, з якими йому коли-небудь доводилося зіштовхнутися.
data.tagline: Абсолютно новий день починається зараз.
data.title: Людина-павук: Абсолютно новий день

data.overview: Peter Parker dnes žije osamělý život. Jeho oběť pro záchranu multivesmíru jej vymazala z paměti a srdcí nejbližších přátel, a tak se z něj stal Spider-Man na plný úvazek. Ochrana města si však vybírá svoji daň a Petr čelí nečekaným fyzickým následkům. Zatímco bojuje o holý život, ve městě se vynořuje temná hrozba s nevídanou mocí. Dokáže Peter zachránit New York, když riskuje, že ztratí i to poslední, co mu zbylo – sama sebe?
data.title: Spider-Man: Zbrusu nový den

data.overview: Spider-Man: Brand New Day คือการเปิดเรื่องราวบทใหม่ของปีเตอร์ พาร์คเกอร์ และสไปเดอร์-แมน สี่ปีผ่านไปนับตั้งแต่เหตุการณ์ใน Spider-Man: No Way Home ปีเตอร์เติบโตเป็นผู้ใหญ่เต็มตัว และใช้ชีวิตเพียงลำพังโดยสมบูรณ์ หลังจากเลือกที่จะลบตัวเองออกจากชีวิตและความทรงจำของคนที่เขารักทั้งหมด ด้วยการต่อสู้กับอาชญากรรมในมหานครนิวยอร์กที่ไม่มีใครจดจำชื่อของเขาได้อีกต่อไป เขาทุ่มเททุกอย่างให้กับการปกป้องเมืองของเขา ด้วยการเป็นสไปเดอร์-แมนเต็มตัว แต่เมื่อภาระหน้าที่ทวีความหนักหน่วง แรงกดดันกลับจุดชนวนให้เกิดการเปลี่ยนแปลงทางร่างกายอย่างคาดไม่ถึง ซึ่งอาจคุกคามการดำรงอยู่ของเขา ขณะเดียวกัน รูปแบบอาชญากรรมปริศนาแบบใหม่ก็เริ่มปรากฏ นำไปสู่ภัยคุกคามที่ทรงพลังที่สุดครั้งหนึ่งเท่าที่เขาเคยเผชิญ
data.title: สไปเดอร์-แมน: แบรนด์ นิว เดย์

data.overview: לאחר שבחר מרצונו למחוק את עצמו מחייהם ומזיכרונותיהם של האנשים שהוא אוהב, פיטר פארקר הוא כעת אדם בוגר שחי לגמרי לבדו. בעודו נלחם בפשע בניו יורק שכבר אינה מכירה את שמו, הוא מקדיש את עצמו לחלוטין להגנה על העיר שלו- ספיידרמן במשרה מלאה, אך ככל שהדרישות ממנו הולכות וגוברות, הלחץ מחולל שינוי פיזי מפתיע המאיים על עצם קיומו. באותה שעה, דפוס חדש ומסתורי של פשעים מוביל להופעתו של אחד האיומים החזקים ביותר שניצב מולם אי פעם.
data.tagline: יום חדש לגמרי מתחיל עכשיו.
data.title: ספיידרמן: יום חדש

data.overview: Walcząc z przestępczością w Nowym Jorku, który nie zna już jego imienia, w pełni poświęcił się ochronie miasta. Gdy rosnące wymagania zaczynają go przytłaczać, presja wywołuje zaskakującą fizyczną przemianę, która zagraża jego istnieniu, podczas gdy nowy, niepokojący schemat zbrodni prowadzi do pojawienia się jednego z najpotężniejszych przeciwników, z jakimi kiedykolwiek się zmierzył.
data.title: Spider-Man: Całkiem nowy dzień

data.overview: 愛する人たちを守るために、彼らの記憶から自らの存在を消すという決断をした『スパイダーマン：ノー・ウェイ・ホーム』の出来事から４年。大人になったピーター・パーカーはスパイダーマンとして、ニューヨークの負う彼の体に驚くべき身体的変異が起こり始める。同時に、街では姿なき不可解な犯罪が頻発。“親愛なる隣人”に、かつて直面したことのない大きな脅威が迫る──。
data.tagline: 誰一人、僕を覚えていなくても守り続ける。
data.title: スパイダーマン：ブランド・ニュー・デイ

data.overview: Четири години след като светът забравя кой е, Питър Паркър се изправя срещу невидим враг. За да спаси Ню Йорк, той трябва да овладее опасна промяна в самия себе си.
data.title: Спайдър-мен: Нов ден

data.overview: Piter Parker kollec təhsilinə diqqət ayırmağa və Hörümçək-Adamı geridə qoymağa çalışır. Lakin yeni təhlükə dostlarını risk altına saldıqda, o, verdiyi vədi pozaraq yenidən kostyumu geyinməli olur və sevdiklərini qorumaq üçün gözlənilməz müttəfiqlə birləşir.
data.title: Hörümçək-Adam: Tamamilə Yeni Gün

data.overview: 繼《蜘蛛俠：不戰無歸》引發連場激戰後，Peter Parker（湯賀蘭 飾）為了守護大局，決定徹底「捨棄」原有身份，將自己從所有摯愛的記憶中完全抹除。四年過後，長大成人的 Peter 於紐約市過著真正「隱姓埋名」的生活。這位無名英雄如今化身為「全職蜘蛛俠」，日以繼夜守護著這個無人知曉他真實身份的城市。 點知守護者唔易做，長期爆肝壓力太大，竟然令佢身體竟然產生恐怖異變，甚至威脅生命！與此同時，一連串離奇罪案席捲紐約，而隱藏背後的，正是Peter有史以來最強大、最深不可測嘅宿敵⋯⋯
data.title: 蜘蛛俠：英雄重生

data.overview: Empat tahun setelah peristiwa Spider-Man: No Way Home, Peter Parker sudah tidak ada lagi dan Spider-Man kini berada di puncak kemampuannya dalam menjaga Kota New York tetap aman. Semuanya berjalan dengan baik hingga serangkaian kejahatan yang tidak biasa menyeret Spider-Man ke dalam jaring misteri yang lebih besar dari apa pun yang pernah ia hadapi sebelumnya. Untuk menghadapi apa yang akan datang, Spider-Man tidak hanya harus berada dalam kondisi fisik dan mental terbaiknya, tetapi juga harus siap menghadapi konsekuensi dari masa lalunya!

स्पाइडर-मैन: नो वे होम की घटनाओं के चार साल बाद, पीटर पार्कर अब इस दुनिया में नहीं है और स्पाइडर-मैन न्यूयॉर्क शहर को सुरक्षित रखने में अपनी पूरी ताकत लगा रहा है। सब कुछ ठीक चल रहा था, तभी अचानक अपराधों की एक असामान्य श्रृंखला शुरू हो जाती है।
data.title: स्पाइडर-मैन: ब्रैंड न्यू डे

data.overview: ஸ்பைடர்-மேன்: நோ வே ஹோம் நிகழ்வுகளுக்கு நான்கு ஆண்டுகளுக்குப் பிறகு, பீட்டர் பார்க்கர் உயிருடன் இல்லை, மேலும் ஸ்பைடர்-மேன் நியூயார்க் நகரத்தைப் பாதுகாப்பதில் தனது உச்சகட்ட திறமையுடன் இருக்கிறான். ஒரு அசாதாரணமான குற்றச் சம்பவம் நிகழும் வரை, எல்லாம் நன்றாகப் போய்க்கொண்டிருந்தது.
data.title: ஸ்பைடர் மேன்: புத்தம் புதிய நாள்

data.overview: Det är en helt ny dag för Peter Parker. I en värld som inte längre minns honom bekämpar han brott som Spider-Man, men stressen över att se sina vänner gå vidare utan honom gör att något inom Peter förändras. Samtidigt är det en förändring som kan vara den enda möjligheten för honom att rädda staden och de som han älskar från en mäktig ny fiende som ingen ens kan se. Världen må ha glömt Peter Parker, men han har inte glömt dem.
data.tagline: En helt ny dag börjar nu. Är du redo?

data.overview: Praėjus penkeriems metams, po to, kai pasaulis pamiršo jo vardą, Piteris tyliai gyvena savo gimtajame Niujorke ir savo mylimąją Em Džei ir geriausią draugą Nedą stebi iš šalies, nes jie jo tiesiog nebepažįsta. Kovodamas su nusikaltimais Niujorke, kuris nebežino jo vardo, jis visiškai atsidavė savo miesto apsaugai – tapo visą laiką dirbančiu Žmogumi-Voru – tačiau, kai jam keliamos užduotys tampa vis sunkesnės, patiriamas spaudimas sukelia netikėtą fizinę evoliuciją, kuri kelia grėsmę jo pačio egzistavimui. Pagalbos Piteris bando ieškoti pas genialų mokslininką Briusą Banerį, tačiau keistas naujas nusikaltimų modelis sukelia vieną galingiausių grėsmių, su kuriomis jam teko susidurti. Atsinaujinęs ir atgimęs žmogus-voras stoja į naują, kol kas sunkiausią savo kovą.
data.title: Žmogus-voras: Nauja diena

data.overview: بينما يواصل "بيتر باركر" حماية المدينة بصفته "الرجل العنكبوت" في عالمٍ لم يعد يتذكره أحد، يجد نفسه وحيدًا وهو يشاهد أصدقاءه القدامى يمضون في حياتهم من دونه. ومع تصاعد الضغوط، يبدأ بالتغير بطريقة قد تعجز قواه عن كبحها. لكن هذا التحول قد يكون أمله الوحيد لمواجهة تهديدٍ غامض وخطير يلوح في الأفق، عدو يمتلك قوة مرعبة لا يستطيع أحد حتى رؤيته، ويهدد المدينة وكل من يهتم "بيتر" لأمرهم.
data.tagline: يوم جديد يبدأ الآن.
data.title: سبايدر-مان: يوم جديد

data.overview: Aizmirstais Pīters Parkers dzīvo viens pats, pilna laika nodarbojoties ar Zirnekļcilvēka pienākumiem, līdz pieaugošais spiediens izraisa bīstamas pārmaiņas un parādās jauns, spēcīgs ienaidnieks.
data.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Jauna diena

data.overview: Minila so štiri leta, odkar smo nazadnje spremljali dogodivščine našega priljubljenega junaka iz soseske. Petra Parkerja ni več, a Spider-Man je na vrhuncu svojih moči in še naprej varuje New York. Našemu anonimnemu junaku gre vse kot po maslu, dokler ga nepričakovana sled zločinov ne potegne v mrežo skrivnosti, kakršne še ni doživel. Da bi se usepešno soočil z izzivi, ki ga čakajo, mora biti Spider-Man ne le telesno, ampak tudi duševno v svoji najboljši formi, prav tako pa mora biti pripravljen sprejeti tudi posledice svoje preteklosti.
data.title: Spider-Man: Nov dan

data.overview: Пітэр Паркер цалкам прысвячае сябе барацьбе са злачыннасцю ў вобразе Чалавека-павука. Але жыць у свеце, дзе яго ніхто не памятае, і назіраць, як былыя сябры рухаюцца далей без яго, становіцца ўсё цяжэй. Напружанне абуджае ў Пітэры небяспечную сілу, якую ён, магчыма, не здолее стрымаць. Аднак менавіта гэтая трансфармацыя можа стаць адзінай надзеяй на выратаванне горада і дарагіх яму людзей ад новай жахлівай пагрозы — магутнага злыдня, якога ніхто не можа ўбачыць.
data.title: Чалавек-павук: Абсалютна новы дзень

data.overview: مبارزهٔ تمام‌وقت با جرم‌وجنایت در نقش مرد عنکبوتی، آن هم در دنیایی که دیگر او را به یاد نمی‌‌آورد، در کنار فشارِ روانیِ تماشای دوستان قدیمی‌اش که بدون او به زندگی خود ادامه می‌دهند، آغازگرِ تغییری در درون پیتر پارکر می‌شود که شاید قدرتِ مهارش را نداشته باشد. با این حال، همین دگرگونیِ درونی ممکن است تنها سدِ راهِ یک تهدید جدید و هولناک علیه شهر و عزیزانش باشد؛ یک شرورِ قدرتمند که هیچ‌کس حتی قادر به دیدنش نیست.
data.tagline: روزی کاملاً نو از همین حالا آغاز می‌شود.
data.title: مرد عنکبوتی: روز کاملاً جدید

data.overview: Het fulltime bestrijden van misdaad als Spider-Man in een wereld die hem niet meer herinnert – en de druk om zijn oude vrienden zonder hem verder te zien gaan – zet een verandering in gang in Peter Parker die hij misschien niet in de hand heeft. Maar die transformatie is wellicht ook het enige dat een schokkende nieuwe dreiging voor de stad en zijn geliefden kan stoppen: een machtige schurk die niemand kan zien.

Четири године након што је цео свет заборавио његов идентитет, Питер Паркер живи у потпуној изолацији и даноноћно штити Њујорк као Спајдермен. Међутим, док покушава да преброди личну усамљеност и чињеницу да су његови пријатељи наставили даље без њега, необичан низ злочина уводи га у нову мрежу мистерије. Док његове супермоћи пролазе кроз изненађујућу и опасну еволуцију, Спајдермен се суочава са моћном претњом која ће га натерати да преиспита своју прошлост и поново пронађе равнотежу између сопствене хуманости и улоге хероја.
data.tagline: Спајдермен: Нови дан
data.title: Спајдермен: Нови дан

data.overview: Han passat quatre anys des dels esdeveniments de No Way Home, i Peter Parker ara és un adult que viu completament sol, ha desaparegut voluntàriament de les vides i records dels que estima. Combatent el crim en una Nova York que ja no coneix el seu nom, s'ha dedicat completament a protegir la seva ciutat, però a mesura que augmenten les exigències sobre ell, la pressió desencadena una evolució física que amenaça la seva existència, alhora que un estrany nou patró de crims dóna lloc a una de les amenaces més poderoses a què s'ha enfrontat.
data.title: Spider-Man: Un nou dia

data.overview: At bekæmpe kriminalitet på fuld tid som Spider-Man i en verden, der ikke husker ham – og presset ved at se hans gamle venner komme videre uden ham – udløser en forandring i Peter Parker, som han måske ikke har magten til at kontrollere. Men den transformation kan også være det eneste, der kan stoppe en chokerende ny trussel mod byen og dem, han elsker – en magtfuld skurk, som ingen engang kan se.

Quatre ans se sont écoulés depuis les événements du film précédent. Peter, désormais adulte, vit seul, ayant volontairement disparu de la vie et des souvenirs de ses proches. Luttant contre le crime dans un New York qui ne le reconnaît plus, il se consacre entièrement à la protection de sa ville – Spider-Man à plein temps – mais à mesure que les responsabilités s'intensifient, la pression provoque une transformation physique surprenante qui menace son existence, tandis qu'un nouveau mode opératoire criminel donne naissance à l'une des menaces les plus redoutables qu'il ait jamais affrontées.
data.tagline: Une toute nouvelle journée commence maintenant.
data.title: Spider-Man : Un jour nouveau

data.overview: Bojovať proti zločinu na plný úväzok ako Spider-Man vo svete, ktorý si naňho nepamätá – a tlak z toho, že vidí svojich starých priateľov žiť ďalej bez neho – vyvoláva v Petrovi Parkerovi zmenu, ktorú možno nedokáže udržať pod kontrolou. Táto transformácia však môže byť zároveň tým jediným, čo dokáže zastaviť šokujúcu novú hrozbu pre mesto a jeho blízkych – mocného zloducha, ktorého nikto nedokáže ani vidieť.
data.tagline: Teraz začína úplne nový deň.
data.title: Spider-Man: Nový deň

data.overview: 彼得·帕克以蜘蛛侠的身份全职打击犯罪，却发现自己的身体发生了无法控制的变化。与此同时，一股神秘而强大的新威胁正向他和所爱之人逼近。
data.title: 蜘蛛人：重生日

data.overview: Prošle su četiri godine od događaja iz Puta bez povratka, a Peter je sada odrastao čovjek koji živi potpuno sam, nakon što je dobrovoljno izbrisao sebe iz života i sjećanja onih koje voli. Boreći se protiv kriminala u New Yorku koji više ne zna njegovo ime, u potpunosti se posvetio zaštiti svog grada - Spider-Man s punim radnim vremenom - no kako se zahtjevi pred njim pojačavaju, pritisak pokreće iznenađujuću fizičku promjenu koja prijeti njegovom postojanju, dok neobičan novi obrazac zločina dovodi do pojave jedne od najmoćnijih prijetnji s kojima se ikada suočio.
data.title: Spider-Man: Novo doba

data.overview: Neljä vuotta sen jälkeen, kun maailma unohti hänen henkilöllisyytensä, aikuinen Peter Parker elää eristyksissä ja omistautuu kokonaan täysipäiväiselle toiminnalleen Hämähäkkimiehenä. Sitten New Yorkia alkaa piinata näkymätön vihollinen, joka kykenee hyppimään ihmiskehosta toiseen ja ohjaamaan heidän tietoisuuttaan. Iskut kohdistuvat erityisesti Department of Damage Control (DODC) -virastoon. Uhaksi paljastuu psyykkisiä voimia käyttävä mutantti Jean Grey, joka etsii kostoa DODC:n sieppaaman sisarensa Saran puolesta. Samaan aikaan Peter Parkerin oma hämähäkki-DNA alkaa mutantoitua hallitsemattomasti raivon ja stressin seurauksena, mikä antaa hänelle muun muassa orgaaniset seitti-indikaattorit - mutta ne ovat samalla uhka hänen terveydelleen. Kohdatessaan vaaran ja huomatessaan MJ:n olevan vaarassa, Peter lyöttäytyy yhteen yllättävien liittolaisten,  kuten Tuomarin ja Hulkin, kanssa pysäyttääkseen kriisin ja pelastaakseen kaupungin.

Å bekjempe kriminalitet på heltid som Spider-Man i en verden som ikke lenger husker ham – kombinert med presset ved å se gamle venner gå videre uten ham – utløser en forandring hos Peter Parker som han kanskje ikke har krefter til å kontrollere. Men denne forvandlingen kan også være det eneste som kan stoppe en sjokkerende ny trussel mot byen og de han elsker – en mektig skurk som ingen engang kan se.

Fulltime vechten tegen de misdaad als Spider-Man in een wereld die hem niet meer herinnert – en de druk om zijn oude vrienden zonder hem verder te zien gaan – leidt tot een verandering bij Peter Parker die hij misschien niet kan beheersen. Maar die transformatie zou wel eens het enige kunnen zijn dat een schokkende nieuwe bedreiging voor de stad en degenen van wie hij houdt kan tegenhouden: een machtige slechterik die niemand zelfs maar kan zien.
